### **Recurrence Relation:**

We can define the recurrence as follows:

$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}
20 & \text{if } n = 0 \\
40 & \text{if } n \mod 12 = 0 \text{ and } n \ne 0 \\

\end{cases}
$$

- For **n = 0**, the value is **20**.
- For **n = 12, 24, 36, ...**, the value is **40**.
- For all other values of **n**, the value is the same as the value **12 positions earlier**, i.e., the sequence is **periodic with period 12** starting from **n = 1**.

```python
def a(n):

    elif n % 12 == 0:

```
